message: ANGEL's VOICE
And then--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~~. Somehow, I'm starting to get really nervous~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Your starring role is somewhere else, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's that, and this is this. Come closer, I say!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. Amyrina has practiced a ton for today, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, that's true, but...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because of that, you couldn't see Amyrina at all, President... Weren't you lonely?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true at all!」

name: Riesling
message: 「And the same goes for you, my lady, does it not?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's not true at aaaaall!」
Though having said that, we actually snuck out night after night and spent time together while I kept her company during singing practice.

name: Riesling
message: 「Your face is slackening into a smile, sir」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe... So this is what it means to be young」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Riesling-san. Thank you very much for your help back then」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all. As a butler, I could ask for nothing more」

name: Riesling
message: 「For it allowed me to witness the radiant smiles of both my lady and Lady Amyrina like this」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu... Ba-dump, ba-dump」

name: Synn
message: 「You're totally stiff as a board, though」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When was Amyrina's turn again?」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is to remain a surprise until the very moment」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeh--! Then how am I supposed to brace myself...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, they're coming out!」
In a steady stream, the choir led by Misa appears in the hall.
Amyrina is nowhere to be seen among them.
They line up in orderly rows and face the audience.
Silence falls, and a mystical atmosphere envelops the venue.
Like the second hand of a clock heralding the beginning, footsteps slowly echo.
And what appeared was--
Amyrina, dressed in the attire of the choir.
To think she'd be entrusted with a solo right from the start.
This truly is a stage prepared just for Amyrina

name: Synn
message: 「Misa sure knows how to pull off something stylish... Right, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina...」
It's no wonder she's entranced.
Certainly, it's a sight so solemn and majestic you can't help but stare.
As the audience watches on, Amyrina slowly steps forward to the center of the line.
Until now, Amyrina would get flustered just from me or everyone looking at her.
For that same girl to appear before us looking this composed and dignified...

name: Amyrina
message: 「It's because you've been by my side the whole time, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
No way.
Woven into a beautiful singing voice that began quietly, Amyrina's voice reached my ears.
I rub my eyes.
Standing before me is, without a doubt, Amyrina.
Yet she's far more captivating than the Amyrina I know--
Today, once again, she lets her Angel's Bless ring out.
Everyone in the venue was listening intently to that voice, completely entranced.
Amyrina has taken the first step toward her grand dream.

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, this isn't the end, Mr. President.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Because you gave me courage, I... I was able to grow this much.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「So... please. From now on, stay with me forever.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Always within reach of my singing voice--」
Amyrina's singing voice soars across the sky.
Someday, surely, every single person living in this world will listen to the gentle melody played by this angel.
